column4: Coal and Peat products include all coals, both primary (including Hard Coal and Lignite/Brown Coal) and derived fuels (including Patent Fuel, Coke over Coke, Gas Coke, BKB, Coke Oven Gas, Blast Furnace Gas and Oxygen Steel Furnace Gas).  Peat is also included in this category.  The corresponding HS 2022 codes for the energy products mentioned are available in https://www.ema.gov.sg/resources/singapore-energy-statistics/technical-notes-glossary

Crude Oil products include Crude Oil, Natural Gas Liquids, Refinery Feedstocks and Additives as well as other Hydrocarbons.  The corresponding HS 2022 codes for the energy products mentioned are available in https://www.ema.gov.sg/resources/singapore-energy-statistics/technical-notes-glossary

Petroleum Products include Ethane, LPG, Aviation Gasoline, Motor Gasoline, Jet Fuel, Kerosene, Gas/Diesel Oil, Fuel Oil, Naphtha, White Spirit, Lubricants, Bitumen, Paraffin Waxes, Petroleum Coke and other Petroleum Products.  The corresponding HS 2022 codes for the energy products mentioned are available in https://www.ema.gov.sg/resources/singapore-energy-statistics/technical-notes-glossary
